basic_info.description: Not your typical San Francisco home. Sitting on a double-wide lot with views of the Pacific, 191 Thrift Street offers a refreshing alternative to your average city home. This thoughtfully updated 4-bedroom, 2-bathroom home features a remodeled kitchen, custom built-in cabinetry, and a spacious open-concept layout perfect for entertaining. A striking picture window anchors the living room, filling the space with natural light. The primary suite includes a generous layout and ensuite bath with double vanity, while three additional bedrooms offer flexibility for guests, a home office, or creative pursuits. Both bathrooms have been stylishly renovated. Outside, enjoy a private backyard retreat ideal for relaxing or entertaining. The home has a freshly modernized faade with new garage doors for 2 car parking. Located in Oceanview with Muni lines nearby, quick freeway access, and proximity to Stonestown Galleria, Ocean Ave dining, SFSU, and City Collegethis is San Francisco living with space to breathe.
